reflections.summary: Won because Gholdengo was an unanswerable threat — immune to all Sneasler moves, super-effective into Sinistcha, and fast enough to clean up after Swampert traded with Dragonite. Swampert's Ice Punch removed Dragonite while Gholdengo handled the Ghost/Grass core. Opponent's g1 four had no real Gholdengo switch-in. Pelipper died early (turn 5 flinch) losing rain, but the core plan survived without Swift Swim speed.
reflections.adjustment: The bring worked but Pelipper was a liability — it died to a Sneasler Fake Out flinch without doing anything beyond setting rain for 4 turns.
